today_content.sher_roman:
Insha ji utho ab kooch karo is shahar mein jee ka lagana kya
Watan nahin ye pardes hai ab yaan der lagana kya
today_content.sher_urdu:
انشاؔ جی اٹھو اب کوچ کرو اس شہر میں جی کا لگانا کیا
وطن نہیں یہ پردیس ہے اب یاں دیر لگانا کیا
today_content.english_translation: Insha, arise and depart; what solace is there in this city, this foreign land where lingering is folly?
today_content.caption:
This yearning to belong, it's a universal ache. Insha, a poet who saw Delhi decline and drifted between courts, knew this feeling intimately. His life was a journey of displacement, finding impermanence even in solace, often urging him to pack up and move on.

From the same ghazal, here are two more couplets:
Ye shaad-e-jahan ik saaya hai, kuchh asal nahin kuchh maya hai
Jis roz se tum ne janma Insha, us roz se tum ko marna kya

Zar-o-maal se kya kaam Insha, jis roop pe ho to marna kya
Qismat mein likhi hai ruswai, apni shohrat ka dikhana kya

Kise tag karoge jo yeh dard samajhta ho?
